column5: カード説明テキスト
Momiji does a huge bite. holding the button makes the attack more powerful.
Borrows water from the mountain to attack. The attack is a bit delayed\, but it's a strong attack.
Make a huge leap to the air and then immediately strike back down.
An upward slashing attack. It can be used for counterattack.
Slashes the wind creating wind ripples. Because it's just a ripple\, the reach is limited.
Bites the opponent\, regardless of where they are. However it is a bit slow because the bite needs preparation.
Leaps away in a very high speed\, and throw bullets in a wide-arc. It's not a strong attack\, but it's fast.
Enters a blocking stance. By pressing the button once again\, Momiji does a rising slash. She's doing this while guarding\, so it's a powerful counter move.
Throws away a bouquet of maple leaves forward. Throws more leaves if the button is held.
Places a trap at her feet. Renders an enemy that steps on it defenseless. If you place more than one\, the old one will disappear\, so be careful.
Enters a defensive stance. If the opponent attacks\, she releases a barrage of bullets.
Jumps and do a spinning attack. It's usable in the air too\, so it's a versatile attack.
Calls forth a waterfall attack straight from the mountain. It doesn't come out very fast\, but it's powerful and covers herself.
Calls forth a gigantic waterfall attack. It's a very powerful attack\, and there is no room for counter attack.
Slashes forward and backward. It is said that she's able to do it as if both slashes happen at the same time.
Momiji does a huge slash. It can be grazed\, but it's very fast. It seems like someone has a similar spellcard.
Creates a wind aura that slowly expands. It actually isn't gentle at all.
Fires bullets in the form of her shield. It's not a very powerful attack\, but it's good for distraction.
Fires a wolf head projectile forward. It's fast and ferocious.
Momiji does a series of massive crunch. She chews harder and bigger everytime\, so it gets more powerful.
A string of Rising Wolf Strike. However the last attack is a downward slam\, so she doesn't call this one Rising Wolf Strike.
Upon casting\, seven bullets in the form of maple shields appear. Even though it's shields\, it's mainly used for attack purpose.
